concepts.proposed_markdown: The separate [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces|Marketplaces guide]] is a route within Adyen for Platforms for a branded marketplace that processes online payments only; its buyers recognize the marketplace brand, while the platform processes on behalf of its users and can split funds before payout. This guide does not identify legal seller, merchant of record or fund ownership for a specific payment. Its dated regional footnote about in-person payments does not override the marketplace online-only criterion. Keep this modern route separate from [[adyen-classic-platforms|Classic Platforms]].
warnings: Marketplace raw line 27 says online payments only, while raw line 99 carries an in-person/store-creation regional footnote; do not infer Marketplace POS support.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplaces route of Adyen for Platforms: branded online-only marketplace model, onboarding/verification, split payments, payout choices, dated region lists and optional financial products.
